bio.text: Jim Costa has represented the San Joaquin Valley in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2005, and represents California's 21st Congressional District.
He served in the California State Assembly from 1978 to 1994 and the California State Senate from 1994 to 2002.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from California State University, Fresno, and grew up working on his family's dairy; he now farms almonds.
